notes.title: 8-bit inspired horror Sunshine Manor to release this Fall and has a new trailer up
notes.notes:
Bringing on some 8-bit inspired horror, Sunshine Manor from Fossil Games is confirmed to be releasing this Fall and the developer put out a new trailer.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/04/8-bit-inspired-horror-sunshine-manor-to-release-this-fall-and-has-a-new-trailer-up
